raw.desc: 紺碧色をした丈夫な獣の皮
raw.name: 紺碧の皮

dictionary.lore: This blue pelt is frequently found in the Kagan Desert and Breezy Beaches of Morgan. Since it's tougher than the Green Pelt it requires a higher degree of skill to work with, but in exchange it does yield equipment with a higher defense rating.
